RELIANCE.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
RELIANCE.about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.
RELIANCE.keyPoints: Architecture Reliance Industries Limited holds key business stakes, including 66.43% in Jio Platforms (RJIL). Additionally, it maintains an 83.56% ownership each in Reliance Retail Ventures and Reliance Consumer Products, alongside a 59.59% holding in JioStar.

HDFCBANK.name: HDFC Bank Ltd
HDFCBANK.about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges.
HDFCBANK.keyPoints: Market Position: The company is India's one of the 3 systemically important banks with a 15% market share in the banking sector’s advances and a 37% market share in the private sector banks’ advances as of FY24. It is also the second-largest bank in India. It is among the top 3 Government Banks collecting direct and indirect taxes for the Government of India. It is a market leader in almost every asset category.

INFY.name: Infosys Ltd
INFY.about: Infosys Ltd provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services to enable clients to execute strategies for their digital transformation. It is the 2nd largest Information Technology company in India behind TCS.
INFY.keyPoints: Digital Services: It comprises of services and solution offerings of the group that enables clients to transform their businesses. It includes offerings that enhance customer experience, leverage AI-based analytics and big data, engineer digital products and IoT, modernize legacy tech systems, migrate to cloud applications and implement advanced cyber-security systems.

BHARTIARTL.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
BHARTIARTL.about: Bharti Airtel Ltd is one of the world’s leading providers of telecommunication services with presence in 18 countries representing India, Sri Lanka, 14 countries in Africa.
BHARTIARTL.keyPoints: Segments & Presence Mobile, Broadband, DTH and Bank. The company has operations in India, Africa, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.

LT.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
LT.about: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate which is primarily engaged in providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions in key sectors such as Infrastructure, Hydrocarbon, Power, Process Industries and Defence, Information Technology and Financial Services in domestic and international markets.
LT.keyPoints: Business Segments a) Infrastructure Projects (47% in FY26 vs 51% in FY25):  The segment undertakes EPC activities across buildings and factories, transportation, heavy civil infrastructure, power transmission and distribution, renewable energy, water and effluent treatment, and minerals and metals sectors.

TITAN.name: Titan Company Ltd
TITAN.about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO).
TITAN.keyPoints: Part of the Tata Group  The company benefits from its association with the Tata Group, one of India’s most established and diversified business conglomerates. As of FY26, the Tata Group held a 25% stake in the company, including a 21% shareholding through Tata Sons Pvt Ltd., while Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation Limited (TIDCO) held 28%.

SUNPHARMA.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
SUNPHARMA.about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, developing and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs). The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India.
SUNPHARMA.keyPoints: Product Offerings: The company produces a range of generic and specialty medications for chronic and acute conditions. Its product portfolio includes generics, branded generics, specialty pharmaceuticals, advanced technology-based products, antiretrovirals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and intermediates. It offers medications in multiple dosage forms, such as injectables, sprays, ointments, creams, liquids, tablets, and capsules. The company offers 27 products in the global specialty market, with a strategic focus on dermatology, ophthalmology, and onco-dermatology segments.

MARUTI.name: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd
MARUTI.about: The Company was established in 1981. A joint venture agreement was signed between the Government of India and Suzuki Motor Corporation (SMC), Japan in 1982. The Company became a subsidiary of SMC in 2002.It is the market leader in passenger vehicle segment in India. In terms of production volume and sales, the Company is now SMC’s largest subsidiary. SMC currently holds 56.28% of its equity stake. The principal activities of the Company are manufacturing, purchase and sale of motor vehicles, components and spare parts.
MARUTI.keyPoints: Segment wise domestic sales 9M FY26 Compact - 41.6% Utility vehicles - 37.7% Vans - 7.3% Mini - 5.3% Mid Size - 0.1% LCV - 2% Sales to other (OEM) - 6%

BAJFINANCE.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
BAJFINANCE.about: Bajaj Finance is mainly engaged in the business of lending. BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)
BAJFINANCE.keyPoints: Business Overview: The company is India's largest private-sector Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), catering to both individual and business customers through a portfolio of financial products and services. Its offerings span loans, fixed deposits, payments, insurance, and mutual funds through its mobile app, website, and social media, and through its branch network.

ETERNAL.name: Eternal Ltd
ETERNAL.about: Incorporated in 2010, Eternal Limited (previously Zomato Limited) is one of the leading online Food Service platforms in terms of the value of food sold. Its offerings include food delivery, dining-out services, Loyalty programs, and others.
ETERNAL.keyPoints: Business Segments - Q2 FY27: Eternal Limited operates four principal businesses: - Zomato (food delivery) - Blinkit (quick commerce) - Hyperpure (B2B supplies) - District (going-out).

TRENT.name: Trent Ltd
TRENT.about: Trent Ltd is engaged in retailing of apparels, footwear, accessories, toys, games, food, grocery & non food products through various of its retail formats/ concepts.
TRENT.keyPoints: Part of Tata Group: The company is a part of the Tata Group with ~37% of group shareholding, 32.5% with Tata Sons Private Ltd & 4.3% with Tata Investment Corporation Ltd.  Tata Group comprises 100 operating companies in 7 business sectors. The group operates in over 80 countries across 6 continents.

DIXON.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
DIXON.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, incorporated in 1993 , is a Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) company with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras (CCTVs), and mobile phones. It also undertakes reverse logistics operations. Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India.
DIXON.keyPoints: Business Segments: a) Mobile & EMS Division (90% in FY26 vs 85% in FY25): The company has emerged as the fastest-growing EMS company by revenue and market capitalisation. It manufactures feature phones, smartphones, IT hardware, Telecom, hearables & wearables. Its key client in this segment includes Samsung. b) Consumer Electronics & Appliances (6% in FY26 vs 9% in FY25): The company offers LED TVs (32-98 inches), Smart TVs, Monitors, IFPD Commercial displays, Digital signage PCB & LCM panel assembly, and LED Bar Injection moulding. It is the largest Original Design Manufacturing (OEM & ODM) company in India, and has a 37% share in outsourced manufacturing. Its clients include Xiaomi, Samsung, Hisense, Panasonic, Acer, Toshiba, BPL, Lloyd, VU, Motorola, etc. c) Home Appliances (3% in FY26 vs 4% in FY25):  The company is an ODM/OEM in India, manufacturing Semi-Automatic Washing Machines (

POLYCAB.name: Polycab India Ltd
POLYCAB.about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.
POLYCAB.keyPoints: Business Segments  a) Wires & Cables (87% in FY26 vs 84% in FY25):   The company is India’s leading manufacturer of wires and cables, including flexible wires, building wires, optical fiber cables, rubber cables, control cables, and special-purpose cables, etc. It offers over 9,650 SKUs across retail and industrial applications and commands a 30-31% share of the organized domestic market.

CGPOWER.name: CG Power & Industrial Solutions Ltd
CGPOWER.about: CG Power & Industrial Solutions is a global enterprise providing end-to-end solutions to utilities, industries and consumers for the management and application of efficient and sustainable electrical energy. It offers products, services and solutions in two main business segments, viz. Power Systems and Industrial Systems.
CGPOWER.keyPoints: Promoter  The company is promoted by Tube Investments of India Ltd, a part of the Murugappa Group, a 124-year-old diversified conglomerate with a global presence and businesses spanning agriculture, engineering, financial services, and other sectors.

DEEPAKNTR.name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
DEEPAKNTR.about: Incorporated in 1970, Deepak Nitrite Ltd manufactures Basic Intermediates, Fine & Speciality Chemicals, Performance Products, and Phenolics
DEEPAKNTR.keyPoints: Business Segments: The company is one of the fastest growing chemical intermediates companies in India with a portfolio of 36+ products and 56+ applications, divided into 2 segments: a) Phenolics (68% in FY26 vs 70% in FY25):  The company produces Cumene, Phenol, Acetone, Isopropyl Alcohol, Alpha Methyl Styrene (AMS), etc., catering to industries like laminates & plywood, automotive, construction, pharmaceuticals, and adhesives. It is the largest producer of Phenol and Acetone in India with a 50% market share. b) Advanced Intermediates (32% in FY26 vs 30% in FY25):  The company manufactures Nitrites, Nitro Toluidines, Xylidines, Oxyimes, Cumidines, Optical Brightening Agents (OBA), DASDA, etc., serving industries like colorants, dyes, rubber, paper, agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, water treatment, etc. It is India's largest producer of Sodium Nitrite and ranks among the top 3 global manu

KAYNES.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
KAYNES.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments.
KAYNES.keyPoints: Business Offerings: The company is a leading provider of end -to-end IoT-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing services (IEMS). It offers a full spectrum of services across the entire electronics value chain, spanning conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support. It has also ventured into Smart Metering, Advanced Semiconductor Packaging (OSAT), High-Density Interconnect PCBs, and AI-Powered Railway Safety.

NAVINFLUOR.name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
NAVINFLUOR.about: Navin Fluorine International Ltd is primary engaged in producing refrigeration gases, inorganic fluorides, specialty organofluorines and offers contract research and manufacturing services. Its portfolio includes 50+ fluorinated compounds developed over the years.
NAVINFLUOR.keyPoints: Overview NFIL, a part of the Padmanabh Mafatlal group, is present in the fluorochemical industry since 1967 and is one of the largest specialty fluorochemical companies and a pioneer in manufacturing of refrigerant gases in India. NFIL’s product portfolio comprises 60+ fluorinated compounds, with them finding application in various industries, like agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, aluminium smelting, refrigeration, metal processing, abrasives, glass and ceramics. The company is currently headed by second-generation entrepreneur, Vishad Mafatlal, who has over 25 years’ experience in textile and chemical sectors

CREDITACC.name: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd
CREDITACC.about: CreditAccess Grameen Limited is registered as a non-deposit accepting NBFC - Microfinance Institution with the RBI. It is engaged in providing microfinance services to women who are enrolled as members and organized as Joint Liability Groups. It also uses its distribution channel to provide certain other financial products and services to the members.
CREDITACC.keyPoints: Market Leadership: CreditAccess Grameen is a microfinance institution in India, providing financial services to low-income households, primarily women, in rural and semi-urban areas. It holds a 6.9% market share in the overall microfinance industry.

PERSISTENT.name: Persistent Systems Ltd
PERSISTENT.about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration . It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS .
PERSISTENT.keyPoints: Solutions Offered  {# The company is a global digital services and solutions provider specializing in AI-led, platform-driven digital engineering and enterprise modernization. It offers end-to-end capabilities across software and product engineering, data and AI, cloud-enabled enterprise modernization, customer experience (CX) transformation, intelligent automation, and analytics. The company serves diverse industries, including software and high-tech, banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), and healthcare and life sciences.
